name: Volume Raycaster Actor
definition: A visualization actor that renders 3-D scalar fields using either iso-surface raycasting or direct volume rendering (DVR). It supports interactive exploration, advanced illumination, shadowing, and normal curves.
summary: The Volume Raycaster Actor renders 3-D scalar fields via iso-surface extraction or direct volume rendering, uniquely allowing independent configuration of multiple iso-surfaces and their shading by secondary variables.
